dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye-bye!"
dialogues.text: "Bye-bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また」
dialogues.en: "Later."
dialogues.text: "Later."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、今日も桜公園に行きません？」
dialogues.en: "Can we go to the Sakura Park again today?"
dialogues.text: "Can we go to the Sakura Park again today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「了解」
dialogues.en: "Understood."
dialogues.text: "Understood."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「昨日に比べると、何か、良くなってきている
　よな」
dialogues.en: "Compared to yesterday, it seems to be much better today."
dialogues.text: "Compared to yesterday, it seems to be much better today."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「歌が、さ。いや、まあ、まるきり素人意見だ
　けど」
dialogues.en:
"Your singing, I mean. Well, nevermind, it's just a
know-nothing's opinion anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Your singing, I mean. Well, nevermind, it's just a
know-nothing's opinion anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか？　朝倉君にそう言ってもらえる
　と嬉しいです……ごほっ」
dialogues.en:
"You think so? But if you really think that, it makes me
happy enough... *cough*"
dialogues.text:
"You think so? But if you really think that, it makes me
happy enough... *cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「後は、その咳さえなけりゃな……」
dialogues.en: "You just need to get rid of that cough..."
dialogues.text: "You just need to get rid of that cough..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、変ですよね。普段の私のパワーなら、
　とっくに治ってるはずなんですけど……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeaaah, it's been so strange. Normally I'm strong enough to
recover from this sort of thing much quicker..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeaaah, it's been so strange. Normally I'm strong enough to
recover from this sort of thing much quicker..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「薬は？」
dialogues.en: "Have you been taking your medicine?"
dialogues.text: "Have you been taking your medicine?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「飲んでます」
dialogues.en: "Yes I have."
dialogues.text: "Yes I have."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、メシは？」
dialogues.en: "Regular meals?"
dialogues.text: "Regular meals?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「きちんと取ってます」
dialogues.en: "On the dot."
dialogues.text: "On the dot."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ。そしたら、睡眠は？」
dialogues.en: "Mm. What about sleep?"
dialogues.text: "Mm. What about sleep?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……それが、割とあくびをこらえていたりす
　るんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"...I've been trying my best not to break into a yawn for
most days."
dialogues.text:
"...I've been trying my best not to break into a yawn for
most days."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　寝てないの？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Not sleeping well? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Not sleeping well? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「本を読んでるんです。声楽の本を……それで、
　ちょっと」
dialogues.en: "I've been reading a book... a book about vocals."
dialogues.text: "I've been reading a book... a book about vocals."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「夜更かし？」
dialogues.en: "And stayed up late doing that?"
dialogues.text: "And stayed up late doing that?"

dialogues.jp: ことりはこくんとうなずいた。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded lightly.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded lightly.

dialogues.jp:
「あかんあかん。そりゃあかんでえ。病人なん
　だから、夜はきちんと寝ないと」
dialogues.en:
"No, no, that's not good at all. Patients should get as much
rest as possible."
dialogues.text:
"No, no, that's not good at all. Patients should get as much
rest as possible."

dialogues.jp: 「子守歌でも歌って、添い寝してやろうか？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you need me to sleep together with you and sing you a
lullaby?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you need me to sleep together with you and sing you a
lullaby?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、えー……駄目ですよ、そんな……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ehhhh-... don't say things like that..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, ehhhh-... don't say things like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、余計に眠れなくなっちゃうじゃない
　ですか……」
dialogues.en:
"I really won't be able to sleep at all if that was the
case..."
dialogues.text:
"I really won't be able to sleep at all if that was the
case..."

dialogues.jp:
ちらりとこちらを窺った視線に、妄想が一気に
膨れ上がる。
dialogues.en:
As she looked at me out of the corner of her eye, I started
getting too wild ideas in my head.
dialogues.text:
As she looked at me out of the corner of her eye, I started
getting too wild ideas in my head.

dialogues.jp:
「あいや、そんなつもりじゃなかったんだけど
　な……」
dialogues.en: "I, I didn't mean it in the way you thought..."
dialogues.text: "I, I didn't mean it in the way you thought..."

dialogues.jp: お馬鹿な冗談だったのだ。それなのに……。
dialogues.en: It was just a stupid joke, that's all..."
dialogues.text: It was just a stupid joke, that's all..."

dialogues.jp:
俺のよこしまな考えに感応したかのように、こ
とりの目元にぼっと火がついた。
dialogues.en:
I turned away from Kotori's face, trying not to immerse
myself anymore into her eyes and those thoughts of mine.
dialogues.text:
I turned away from Kotori's face, trying not to immerse
myself anymore into her eyes and those thoughts of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う……こほん」
dialogues.en: "Uh... ahem."
dialogues.text: "Uh... ahem."

dialogues.jp:
話題にうっちゃりをかますべく、起死回生の咳
払いを敢行した。
dialogues.en: I cleared my throat, and got ready to change the topic.
dialogues.text: I cleared my throat, and got ready to change the topic.

dialogues.jp:
「あ〜と、でもさ、ちゃんと休んだ方がいいぜ？
　夜は」
dialogues.en: "Aaaanyway, you should really rest more at night."
dialogues.text: "Aaaanyway, you should really rest more at night."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……。なんて言うか、テストが間近に
　迫っているような心境なんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"I know... it somehow feels like when a major exam is coming
up..."
dialogues.text:
"I know... it somehow feels like when a major exam is coming
up..."

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、うっちゃりは成功したらしかった。
ホッと息をつく。
dialogues.en: Looks like the plan worked. I let out my held breath.
dialogues.text: Looks like the plan worked. I let out my held breath.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何だか、何かをやっていないと不安で、それ
　で……」
dialogues.en:
"I guess I'm still unsure of myself on whether I can do
it..."
dialogues.text:
"I guess I'm still unsure of myself on whether I can do
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、今日良くなっていたのは、本を読んで
　いたから？」
dialogues.en:
"So today, are you going to try not reading your book
instead?"
dialogues.text:
"So today, are you going to try not reading your book
instead?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。そんなすぐには変わりませんよ」
dialogues.en: "No, that won't change."
dialogues.text: "No, that won't change."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、意味ないじゃん」
dialogues.en: "Then there's no way you could sleep early."
dialogues.text: "Then there's no way you could sleep early."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……まあ、気休めです」
dialogues.en: "Well, yes... but it just eases my mind."
dialogues.text: "Well, yes... but it just eases my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりさんや」
dialogues.en: "Kotori-san."
dialogues.text: "Kotori-san."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: 俺はおごそかに託宣を下した。
dialogues.en: I addressed her in a purely dignified manner.
dialogues.text: I addressed her in a purely dignified manner.

dialogues.jp: 「寝なさい」
dialogues.en: "Sleep well tonight."
dialogues.text: "Sleep well tonight."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: そして、例の場所へ。
dialogues.en: Then, we continued heading towards that place.
dialogues.text: Then, we continued heading towards that place.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず深い静寂に閉ざされて、十年一日を
地で行くような場所。
dialogues.en:
For 10 years, this place has remained it's silent, usual
self.
dialogues.text:
For 10 years, this place has remained it's silent, usual
self.

dialogues.jp:
ひょいと首を巡らせれば、木の裏側から、幼い
頃の俺やさくらがひょっこり顔を覗かせるよう
な、そんな気がしてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly remembered the times Sakura and I would play
around here, peeping into the holes in the giant tree.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly remembered the times Sakura and I would play
around here, peeping into the holes in the giant tree.

dialogues.jp: （ま、さくらは今も昔も外見は変わらんけど）
dialogues.en:
"(Well, even Sakura hasn't changed in terms of her
appearance...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Well, even Sakura hasn't changed in terms of her
appearance...)"

dialogues.jp:
「でも、声楽の本を読んでる事が、調子に関係
　ないんだったら……」
dialogues.en:
"But reading a music book or not shouldn't affect your
condition at all..."
dialogues.text:
"But reading a music book or not shouldn't affect your
condition at all..."

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、あの邪魔くさいギャラリーが居な
　いから？」
dialogues.en: "In the end, maybe it was still that annoying gallery?"
dialogues.text: "In the end, maybe it was still that annoying gallery?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そういう事になりますね」
dialogues.en: "...That was probably a factor as well."
dialogues.text: "...That was probably a factor as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「正直言って、キツかったですよ、あの状況は
　……」
dialogues.en: "To be honest, at that time, I really felt horrible..."
dialogues.text: "To be honest, at that time, I really felt horrible..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあな。それにあの連中、妙に幽霊みたいな、
　冷た〜い顔してやがったし」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, really. Your face was as pale as a ghost then."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, really. Your face was as pale as a ghost then."

dialogues.jp:
今振り返ると、映画“ゾンビ”の世界に紛れ込
んだような、そんな状況だった。
dialogues.en:
It was the kind of situation where you'd nervously look over
your shoulder to check for zombies.
dialogues.text:
It was the kind of situation where you'd nervously look over
your shoulder to check for zombies.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「みんな……勝手なんですよね」
dialogues.en: "Everyone... always wants what they want."
dialogues.text: "Everyone... always wants what they want."

dialogues.jp: 黙って、ことりの顔を見る。
dialogues.en: I stayed silent, and looked at Kotori.
dialogues.text: I stayed silent, and looked at Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
こめかみに指をあて、軽く顔をしかめたことり
は、桜の大木を仰ぎ見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Placing her fingers to her temples, she looked upwards at
the giant sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
Placing her fingers to her temples, she looked upwards at
the giant sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「みんな……みんな、私に何を期待してるんだ
　ろう……」
dialogues.en:
"Everyone... everyone's always expecting something from
me..."
dialogues.text:
"Everyone... everyone's always expecting something from
me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……私を何だと思っているんだろう……？」
dialogues.en: "...What am I supposed to think about that...?"
dialogues.text: "...What am I supposed to think about that...?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いつだって私は、上手くやらないといけない
　のかな……？」
dialogues.en:
"When did I become so good as to deserve that kind of
attention...?"
dialogues.text:
"When did I become so good as to deserve that kind of
attention...?"

dialogues.jp: ──期待はずれ。
dialogues.en: --Expectation.
dialogues.text: --Expectation.

dialogues.jp:
それが、あの時の連中が醸し出していた雰囲気
だった。
dialogues.en:
That, oozing out from the people yesterday, was what caused
that situation to come about.
dialogues.text:
That, oozing out from the people yesterday, was what caused
that situation to come about.

dialogues.jp: （学園のアイドル──か）
dialogues.en: "(The school idol, huh.)"
dialogues.text: "(The school idol, huh.)"

dialogues.jp: 結局、そういう事なんだろう。
dialogues.en: In the end, it was all about that.
dialogues.text: In the end, it was all about that.

dialogues.jp:
俺自身は意識した事はないけれど、ことりは、
風見学園では紛れもなくそういう存在だ。
dialogues.en:
As far as I could know, Kotori didn't come by that title by
chance.
dialogues.text:
As far as I could know, Kotori didn't come by that title by
chance.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、紛れもなく生身の人間なのに。けれ
ど、かけ離れた像は、ガンみたいに増大してい
く。
dialogues.en:
Her general personality and talents brought it about, even
if she didn't particularly want it.
dialogues.text:
Her general personality and talents brought it about, even
if she didn't particularly want it.

dialogues.jp:
連中の間では、偶像の張りぼてが、肉付けが、
際限なく厚みを増していく。
dialogues.en:
And from that image of an idol, everyone started expecting
her to be things others aren't, just because of that title.
dialogues.text:
And from that image of an idol, everyone started expecting
her to be things others aren't, just because of that title.

dialogues.jp: そして──勝手に幻滅した。
dialogues.en: That was-- what they want to see, a disillusionment.
dialogues.text: That was-- what they want to see, a disillusionment.

dialogues.jp:
勝手にしやがれってところだけど、押しつけら
れる方にしたら｛たま／堪｝らないだろう。
dialogues.en:
It was the kind of image that she didn't want, yet she's
been so unfairly burdened with it.
dialogues.text:
It was the kind of image that she didn't want, yet she's
been so unfairly burdened with it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「卒業パーティーも……あれの延長線上にある
　んでしょうかね？」
dialogues.en:
"And at the graduation party... it'd be even longer, won't
it?"
dialogues.text:
"And at the graduation party... it'd be even longer, won't
it?"

dialogues.jp: 悲しげに首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori bowed her head sadly.
dialogues.text: Kotori bowed her head sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "I am--"
dialogues.text: "I am--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
さくさくと桜に歩み寄る。こつこつと幹を叩い
た。
dialogues.en:
The sakura petals danced between us, constantly striking the
giant sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
The sakura petals danced between us, constantly striking the
giant sakura tree.

dialogues.jp:
「早く、練習始めようぜ。自分のために。それ
　から、みっくんとともちゃんのために」
dialogues.en:
"Start your practice now. For yourself. And for Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan."
dialogues.text:
"Start your practice now. For yourself. And for Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan."

dialogues.jp: 「ことりは、歌が好きなんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "You like singing, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "You like singing, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね」
dialogues.en: "...Yes I do."
dialogues.text: "...Yes I do."

dialogues.jp:
ふうと息をつくと、ことりは桜の向こう側に回っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Taking a deep breath, Kotori walked up to the base of the
sakura tree, and around it.
dialogues.text:
Taking a deep breath, Kotori walked up to the base of the
sakura tree, and around it.

dialogues.jp: 太い幹に隠され、姿が完全に見えなくなる。
dialogues.en: The huge trunk completely obscured her figure from my sight.
dialogues.text: The huge trunk completely obscured her figure from my sight.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん。歌おっと」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I'd keep singing."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I'd keep singing."

dialogues.jp:
桜にもたれかかる。樹皮を通して、ことりの体
温が伝わってきたような気がした。
dialogues.en:
The sakura petals started revolving around the base of the
tree, as if drawn there by Kotori.
dialogues.text:
The sakura petals started revolving around the base of the
tree, as if drawn there by Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私のために。ふたりの友達のために」
dialogues.en: "For myself. For my friends."
dialogues.text: "For myself. For my friends."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それと──」
dialogues.en: "And also--"
dialogues.text: "And also--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「優しい、マネージャーさんのために」
dialogues.en: "For my kind manager."
dialogues.text: "For my kind manager."

dialogues.jp: ◆練習の後２◆
dialogues.en: ◆After Practice 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆After Practice 2◆

dialogues.jp:
練習が終わって、ことりと二人で、前のように
桜公園へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
Like yesterday, the two of us headed to the Sakura Park
after practice was over.
dialogues.text:
Like yesterday, the two of us headed to the Sakura Park
after practice was over.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは昨日の出来事を気にしているらしかっ
た。ことりは、自分の意志とは裏腹に、他の連
中からアイドル視されていた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was still worried about yesterday's events. Against
her own will, she was made an idol of the school.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was still worried about yesterday's events. Against
her own will, she was made an idol of the school.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、そうだから歌う訳ではないだろう。歌
が好きだから歌う。そうに決まっていた。
dialogues.en:
But that isn't why she keeps singing. It's because she loves
to sing.
dialogues.text:
But that isn't why she keeps singing. It's because she loves
to sing.
